purpose: Canonicalize intent boundaries that must agree with production action routing before another human-label round.

PRODUCT_CONSULT.definition: Ask about attributes, compatibility, suitability, or comparison without requesting a candidate list.

PRODUCT_SEARCH.definition: Find, filter, recommend, or refine a list of products, including 换一批、再推荐 and prior-result constraint changes.

PRODUCT_REVIEW.definition: Create an initial product review or ask about review/recomment entry and rules.

RECOMMENT.definition: Append a follow-up review (追评/追加评价) to an identified order; this is not product recommendation refinement.

invariants: A single enum value must not map both to catalog retrieval and to an order write proposal.
Recommendation refinement remains PRODUCT_SEARCH because it routes to catalog retrieval.
RECOMMENT remains the historical production spelling for an order-bound follow-up review.
note: This contract corrects a discovered v2 annotation-guideline collision. Existing HUMAN_VERIFIED artifacts stay immutable and require independent re-adjudication; this file is not itself human evidence.
